label: AGENTS.md section 9 names only runtime agent directories and states no roster, class or count; the canonical roster is .skilled/agents/README.txt:18 with 11 names, so the cli-* count claims have no AGENTS.md source of truth to match.

/doctor:ci report prints Switch on for dependabot-auto-merge.yml although the CI profile marks it exempt and neither job carries a SKILLED_CI condition; under --no-gh every switched workflow reads unknown, so on conflates no switch with a switch set on.

Workflow claim audit: 32 workflows and 45 jobs; 45 timeout-minutes keys; all 32 files carry top-level permissions; 43 switched jobs all reference SKILLED_CI plus one group; 30/32 use pull-request-only cancel-in-progress and the two exceptions never run on a pull-request push; README group membership matches every file; /doctor:ci report resolves all 32 purposes with zero drift flags and STATUS=OK. No drift against the v4.0.0.16 CI note.

Agent roster: .skilled/agents has 11 canonical files and .claude, .opencode, .codex, .cursor, .pi, .devin and .dsh mirrors each carry the same 11 (claude adds the sanctioned Explore.md); cli-* docs disagree at 10, 11 and 13.
